name: Warfare
desc:
Welcome to Warfare!

A large-scale tactical team combat experience where every second counts. Capture objectives, coordinate with your squad, and outplay the opposing team across dynamic frontlines.

Choose your loadout, adapt to the map, and use teamwork, positioning, and strategy to secure victory!

⚠️ This experience is still in development. Expect bugs, missing features, and frequent updates as we add new content.

🔴 Exploiters will be permanently banned.

Like and favorite to stay updated on new updates and content!
